- **Scheduled:** "Pod end of day" job `0722652367b4` posts to #strategic-pod on weekdays at 17:30 Chicago time. It lists the day's new messages there.
- **Not active yet:** the Hermes gateway isn't running on this host, so the job won't fire until it's started (`hermes gateway start`).

In #strategic-pod I replied to your message with the setup note, then a correction. The correction said the host clock doesn't match the workspace clock, which I haven't verified. I should have said that was unconfirmed.
